title: CI/CD: fix stale workflows (dead steveyegge/beads URLs, bd 1.0.5 → 1.3.0, add Emacs 31.1 to matrix); gascity.el: create workflows from scratch (test matrix + gc v1.4.2 install + gate.sh), fix issues found on latest emacs
description:
Set up and fix CI/CD for the r0man/beads.el and r0man/gascity.el GitHub repos
(emacs lisp packages built with Eldev). The two repos differ in CI maturity:
beads.el HAS workflows (but stale), gascity.el has NONE. Mayor's
reconnaissance (2026-09-24) — verified live:

## Repo state

- beads.el (.github/workflows/{test,lint,coverage,claude,claude-code-review}.yml):
  - test.yml: matrix emacs 29.4/30.2/snapshot, installs bd v1.0.5 from
    steveyegge/beads — STALE: steveyegge/beads moved to gastownhall/beads
    (API 301s now), and bd v1.3.0's release asset naming changed:
    beads_1.3.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz at github.com/gastownhall/beads/releases
    (contains bd at tarball top, ~53MB, glibc-dynamic — fine on ubuntu
    runners). v1.3.1-rc.1 exists; pin to the latest STABLE (v1.3.0).
  - The test matrix's "latest emacs release" gap: GNU released 31.1 (it is
    the user's daily driver and this repo's own follow-ups mention the
    Emacs 31.1 if-let* deprecation). Matrix must cover 29.4 (floor per
    Package-Requires), 30.2, 31.1 (NEW latest release), snapshot.
  - lint.yml + coverage.yml pin 30.2 and bd 1.0.5 — bump both.
- gascity.el: NO .github at all. Package-Requires emacs 29.1; tests are
  ERT via Eldev (scripts/gate.sh = compile --warnings-as-errors + test;
  413 tests pass locally on Emacs 31.1). Tests mock/skip gc: pure tests
  run anywhere, integration tests skip-unless (executable-find gc). CI
  should install gc v1.4.2 from
  github.com/gastownhall/gascity/releases/download/v1.4.2/gascity_1.4.2_linux_amd64.tar.gz
  (static Go binary at tarball top; locally verified runnable) so the
  skip-gated tests actually run. Note gascity.el's Eldev resolves the
  beads.el dependency from a sibling checkout — on CI use melpa (beads
  0.1.0 is on MELPA per Package-Requires) or fetch beads.el from
  github:r0man/beads.el in the workflow if melpa lags.
- BOTH repos: r0man/<name> are the canonical remotes; upstream release
  sources are gastownhall/beads and gastownhall/gascity.

## The task

1. beads.el: update all three workflows:
   - bd install: gastownhall/beads release v1.3.0
     (beads_1.3.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz; keep `| sudo tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin bd`
     — verified the tarball contains `bd` at top). Consider checksum
     pinning via checksums.txt for reproducibility.
   - test matrix: 29.4 / 30.2 / 31.1 / snapshot (keep 29.4
     continue-on-error; drop nothing else).
   - lint + coverage: bump Emacs to 31.1 and bd to v1.3.0.
   - Verify the workflows reference repos that exist (steveyegge/beads is
     dead — release URLs 301 now).
2. gascity.el: CREATE .github/workflows/ from scratch:
   - test.yml: matrix 29.4/30.2/31.1/snapshot, Eldev cache, install gc
     v1.4.2 (static binary, no dolt needed unless tests demand it —
     check: integration tests skip without a city; consider `gc init` in a
     temp dir to enable them, verify what they need), run
     `scripts/gate.sh` (compile --warnings-as-errors + test) as the CI
     step — that is the repo's canonical gate.
   - lint.yml: Emacs 31.1, package-lint via eldev lint.
   - Mirror beads.el's workflow conventions (naming, caching, checkout
     action versions) so the two repos stay consistent.
3. Local verification BEFORE pushing (this repo has emacs 31.1 = the new
   matrix entry): run scripts/gate.sh (eldev compile --warnings-as-errors +
   eldev test — mayor verified 413/413 pass + clean compile on 31.1 in the
   launcher root on 2026-09-24). For beads.el, run `eldev test` locally too
   and record results.
4. Fix any issues found: if 31.1 emits new byte-compile warnings that break
   --warnings-as-errors, fix the elisp (this is IN SCOPE — the user asked
   to fix issues found). Known lead: if-let → if-let* deprecation (see
   beads.el/ga-3dlf in the gascity rig — coordinate; fixing it here may
   close that item too).
5. Commit to main and push (polecat direct-commit contract). Workflows only
   take effect after push — report the Actions URL after pushing. If a CI
   run fails on the runner, read the logs (gh run view / gh api) and iterate
   until green or a clearly-documented blocker.

## Constraints

- Local commits to main are fine; NO upstream PRs. Push to origin (r0man/*).
- Do NOT bump Package-Requires emacs floors without a failing test proving
  the need.
- bd/gc versions in CI: pin exact releases (v1.3.0 for bd, v1.4.2 for gc);
  note in the workflow comments how to bump.
- parenmedic CLI for elisp paren issues (city-wide standing instruction).
- Report: what changed per repo/workflow, CI run URLs, and any failures
  fixed with evidence (the failing test + the fix).

title: Sync beads.el with bd 1.3.x: command-class audit, show-buffer full-parity rendering, local+TRAMP UI verification
description:
Audit and bring beads.el (the Emacs mode for the bd CLI) up to date with the
beads 1.3.x releases, then verify the UI works flawlessly locally and over
TRAMP, using the live ~/bright-lights city for testing.

## Part 1 — CLI sync audit (command classes vs bd 1.3.x)

The bd CLI (v1.3.0+; source checkout at ~/workspace/beads — READ ONLY, this
task is beads.el work) has grown substantially. Its command groups as of
1.3.0 (`bd --help`):

- Issues: assign, children, close, comment, comments, create, create-form,
  delete, edit, gate, heartbeat, label, link, list, merge-slot, note,
  priority, promote, provenance, q, query, reclaim, reopen, search,
  set-state, show, state, tag, todo, unclaim, update
- Views & reports: count, diff, find-duplicates, history, lint, stale,
  status, statuses, types
- Deps & structure: dep, duplicate, duplicates, epic, graph, supersede, swarm
- Sync & data: backup, branch, conflicts, export, import, restore, sync, vc
- Setup & config: bootstrap, config, context, dolt, info, init, kv,
  memories/remember/recall/forget, migrate-personal, onboard, prime,
  quickstart, setup, where
- Maintenance: batch, compact, doctor, events, flatten, gc, migrate, ping,
  preflight, prune, purge, recompute-blocked, rename-prefix, rules, sql,
  upgrade, worktree
- Advanced: admin, jira, linear, repo, ado, audit, blocked, completion, cook,
  defer, formula, github, gitlab, mail, metrics, mol, notion, orphans, ready,
  rename, schema, serve, ship, undefer, version

beads.el currently has command classes for: admin audit batch blocked branch
close comments compact config count create defer delete dep diff doctor dolt
edit epic federation formula gate graph history hooks info init integrations
label list merge-slot migrate misc mol ping prune quickstart ready reopen
restore search show sql stale state status swarm update vc worktree
(lisp/beads-command-*.el).

Method: diff the actual CLI surface (`bd <cmd> --help` for every command,
including flag changes since the version beads.el was written against) vs
the beads-command-*.el classes and their transient menus. Classify each gap:
(1) core user-facing command missing entirely, (2) existing class missing
new flags/options of 1.3.x, (3) deliberately out-of-scope delegators
(jira/linear/github/notion/serve/completion — likely fine to skip, but state
the decision). Implement (1); extend (2). Consult the beads CHANGELOG
(~/workspace/beads/CHANGELOG.md — Unreleased + 1.3.x sections) for behavior
changes that need UI follow-through, not just new commands.

## Part 2 — `bd show` rendering is out of date (user-reported, highest priority)

The user compared `bd show ga-ki0j` (terminal) with the Emacs show buffer and
the Emacs render is missing information. Concrete gaps observed by the mayor
(2026-09-24, against bd 1.3.0):

Terminal `bd show ga-ki0j` renders sections the Emacs buffer does not:
- METADATA: the `metadata` map (e.g. gc.formula_name, gc.build.*_path keys)
  — `bd show --json --long` exposes it; the Emacs render omits or truncates it.
- LABELS section (JSON omits the key entirely when empty — render must
  distinguish "absent" from "empty").
- NOTES (appended notes) and LEASE (expires-in / heartbeat) sections.
- TRACKS / TRACKED BY (traversal of dep graph beyond direct dependencies).
- Close reason / outcome lines on closed beads.
- description/design/acceptance-criteria sections and comment threads.

Bring the show buffer to full parity with terminal `bd show` (and prefer
`--json --long` as the data source; handle every field the 1.3.0 schema
defines — see `bd schema`). Sections that are empty should render dim or be
omitted consistently, not disappear the underlying data. Include the
newer show flags (--long, --as-of, --refs, --children, --local-time) in the
transient menu.

## Part 3 — UI verification pass, local + TRAMP (most important)

Exercise the whole beads.el UI against the live ~/bright-lights city
(/home/roman/bright-lights — running city with mayor session, hello-world
rig, and its own beads store) in BOTH access modes:
- local: /home/roman/bright-lights
- TRAMP: /ssh:localhost:/home/roman/bright-lights

Checklist (use the e2e harness with timeout(1) bounds for batch emacs
invocations — see gascity.el's docs/qa/2026-09-24-ga-pf3c-dogfood-e2e.md for
the pattern; no blocking emacs/tmux calls):
1. Status/overview buffers render against the live store.
2. list / ready / blocked / count views: render, sort, RET drill-in.
3. show buffer for a rich bead (workflow bead with metadata, labels, deps,
   notes) — verify Part 2 parity in both modes.
4. Create / update / close / comment / label / dep operations end-to-end;
   create a trivial test bead in the bright-lights store and clean it up.
5. Transient menus: every option in the key menus maps to a valid bd 1.3.0
   flag (stale flags from older bd are outright bugs).
6. Error surfacing: bd's JSON error envelopes render readably; TRAMP
   failures (slow inner shell, HISTFILE pollution) don't wedge buffers.
7. eldoc/completion still resolve ids asynchronously (f2b4e2c regression
   check).

Deliverables: audit table (bd 1.3.x command × beads.el class × status),
implemented gaps + flag extensions, show-buffer parity work, dogfood report
per access mode with anything that silently degraded, and ERT coverage for
new classes/parsers (scripts/gate.sh green). Local commits to main are fine
(polecat contract); no upstream PRs.

## Constraints

- beads.el repo only (~workspace/beads.el). READ-ONLY on ~/workspace/beads
  (Go repo). Local commits to main are fine; NO upstream PRs.
- bd CLI at 1.3.0 is already installed and the target version — pin behavior
  to what `bd schema` documents, not to older JSON shapes.
- If paren issues arise in elisp editing, use the parenmedic CLI (city-wide
  standing instruction).
